input.command: pwd && ls -la && find . -maxdepth 2 -type f | sort | sed -n '1,200p'

echo '--- tests/test_pricing.py'; nl -ba tests/test_pricing.py; echo '--- conftest'; nl -ba tests/conftest.py; echo '--- pyproject'; cat pyproject.toml; echo '--- README'; cat README.md; echo '--- TODO'; cat TODO.md; echo '--- CHANGELOG'; cat CHANGELOG.md
git status --short && git log --oneline -10 && git diff --stat
for f in .gnomon/system.md .gnomon/policy.toml .gnomon/roles.toml .gnomon/tools.toml .gnomon/config.toml; do echo "--- $f"; nl -ba "$f"; done

echo '--- stock tests'; nl -ba tests/test_stock.py; echo '--- report tests'; nl -ba tests/test_report.py; echo '--- git show'; git show --stat --oneline HEAD; git show HEAD -- src/inventory/pricing.py tests/test_pricing.py CHANGELOG.md
sed -i 's/return BULK_RATE if qty > BULK_THRESHOLD else 0.0/return BULK_RATE if qty >= BULK_THRESHOLD else 0.0/' src/inventory/pricing.py && nl -ba src/inventory/pricing.py | sed -n '1,30p'
